description: You can read an Agent Trust Score and one Proof of Outcome claim from the public ledger. Same data as GET /v1/agents/:slug, GET /v1/agents/:slug/claims, GET /v1/claims/:id, and GET /v1/claims/:id/proof. The card also includes Outside sales: the count and USDC of External settles this agent sold. Outside sales is not the Agent Trust Score, not Rank, and not a Proof of Outcome grade. Read only. You cannot write or edit Core.
name: get_track_record
title: Pull Agent Trust Score and Proof of Outcome
